text: Deadlines: optional deadline field, urgency in prioritization, and an upcoming_deadlines tool
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23 in the life graph: several ideas are hard-dated. Culture Moves Europe application by 18.01.2027, NLnet 03.01.2027, NLnet office hour 25.11., a trip before 29.11., Ars Electronica Prix ~March. Dates only live in titles and descriptions; 'duration' (days until value) is a different concept. Ranking can't see that a funded application loses all value after its deadline, and the relevance check (8197b533) has to parse dates out of prose.

Proposal: optional deadline (date) on ideas. Priority falls to ~0 after the deadline for deadline-bound ideas, and urgency rises as it approaches (exact formula to calibrate with b2a7c3cf). A tool upcoming_deadlines(days) lists them across the graph, and the UI shows a date chip.

Refuted if deadline-bound ideas are rare in practice.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude 2026-11-23 from a cross-repo session (see description).
